methodology: Each required real application is built twice from identical source and identical Vite 8/Rolldown/Oxc production settings. Only Vue package resolution changes. Candidate graphs contain only VueLil implementation modules, with retained inlined host-adapter code counted. Every emitted deployment asset is scored independently and summed; published Vue distribution sizes are not used as the gate.
objective: Every completion-required project has a smaller candidate Brotli-11 deployment.

adapters.accounting: inlined into VueLil before Vite; all retained bytes are measured in emitted assets
